import sys

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    ones = [0] * 17
    for i in range(1, 17):
        ones[i] = 10 * ones[i-1] + 1

    def dfs(n, idx):
        quot = n // ones[idx]
        n %= ones[idx]
        ones_used_here = quot * idx
        if n == 0:
            return ones_used_here
        else:
            return ones_used_here + min(dfs(n, idx-1), idx + dfs(ones[idx] - n, idx-1))

    ans = dfs(n, 16)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
